arguments.summary: The pgbouncer service was degraded with 100 connections in use. There were 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table which were blocking the retry queue. These rows have been deleted and the pgbouncer service restarted. The failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for any further issues and ensure proper validation of jobs before they are added to the queue.
